'''Philip Rosenau''' ({{langx|he|פיליפ רוזנאו}}; born 1946), is an Israeli [[mathematician]]<ref>[http://www.math.tau.ac.il/~rosenau/ Philip Rosenau's homepage at Tel Aviv University]</ref> and a poet.<ref>[http://simania.co.il/authorDetails.php?itemId=56652 Philip Rosenau's books of poetry in Hebrew at simania.com]<br>לבוא חשבו (Come to thinking)<br>
מחשבות טעונות טיפוח (Thoughts disadvantaged)<br>
ספני השפל (Depression sailors)<br>
ספני השפל : שיר 2007-1991 (Depression sailors: Poems 1991-2007)</ref> He is a professor at the Department of [[Applied Mathematics]] at [[Tel Aviv University]]. He introduced [[compacton]]s,<ref>{{cite journal|author=Rosenau, Philip|author2=Hyman, James M.|title=Compactons: Solitons with finite wavelength|journal=Phys. Rev. Lett.|date=1 February 1993|volume=70|issue=5|pages=564–567|url=http://prl.aps.org/abstract/PRL/v70/i5/p564_1|doi=10.1103/physrevlett.70.564|pmid=10054146|bibcode=1993PhRvL..70..564R |url-access=subscription}}</ref> along with [[James (Mac) Hyman|James M. Hyman]].
